&nbsp;Job Position: Supply Chain Officer
Job Location: Lekki, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	Our client in the agro sector is seeking an experienced and highly organized Supply Chain Officer to join their team.
	The ideal candidate should have solid experience in supply chain management, logistics, procurement, and export operations, with a good understanding of the processes involved in moving agricultural products from sourcing to local and international markets.


Key Responsibilities


	Coordinate end-to-end supply chain and logistics operations.
	Manage the movement of agricultural products from suppliers to warehouses, customers, and export destinations.
	Coordinate export documentation, shipping schedules, and logistics arrangements.
	Liaise with freight forwarders, shipping lines, customs agents, and other relevant stakeholders.
	Ensure compliance with export regulations, documentation requirements, and international trade procedures.
	Monitor inventory levels and coordinate stock movement to ensure timely deliveries.
	Track shipments and provide updates on delivery and export status.
	Support procurement and supplier management activities.
	Prepare and maintain accurate supply chain, logistics, and export records.
	Identify and resolve supply chain and logistics challenges.
	Monitor transportation costs and support cost-effective logistics planning.
	Ensure proper handling, packaging, and documentation of agro products for export.


Requirements


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree/HND in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, Transport Management, or a related field.
	Minimum of 3&ndash;5 years of relevant experience in supply chain, logistics, or procurement, preferably within the agro sector.
	Strong understanding of export operations and international trade procedures.
	Practical knowledge of export documentation, shipping processes, customs procedures, and freight forwarding.
	Experience coordinating the export of agricultural products will be a strong advantage.
	Good knowledge of inventory management, procurement, and logistics operations.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and relevant supply chain/logistics software.
	Strong negotiation, coordination, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
	Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
	Ability to work effectively with suppliers, logistics providers, customers, and international partners.


Salary
N200,000 - N300,000 monthly.

Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: Addozrecruitment@gmail.com using &ldquo;Supply Chain Officer &ndash; Lekki&rdquo; as the subject of the email.",

Account Officer Job at Matrix Homes and Properties Limited




        
    

        
        Matrix Homes and Properties Limited is a reputable Real Estate Company based in Lagos, Nigeria. As a real estate developer and investment company, Matrix Homes offers services such as property development, sales, and investment. We focus on making home acquisition affordable to all Nigerians while maintaining high standards of quality and integrity.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Account Officer

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	Oversee the Company's financial operations by ensuring accurate financial reporting, effective budgeting, cash flow management, and compliance with applicable accounting standards and statutory regulations.
	Manage project and property accounting, including monitoring development costs, construction expenditures, property sales, rental income, and profitability to support sound financial decision-making.
	Establish and maintain robust internal controls, accounting policies, and financial systems to safeguard Company assets, mitigate financial risks, and improve operational efficiency.
	Ensure timely preparation of financial statements, tax filings, statutory remittances, and audit requirements while maintaining compliance with ISO 9001:2015 standards for financial documentation and process control.
	Provide strategic financial leadership by supervising the accounting team, advising Management on financial performance and investment decisions, and supporting the achievement of the Company's business objectives.


Key Responsibilities


	Prepare and review financial statements, ensuring compliance with IFRS, statutory requirements, and Company policies.
	Oversee the general ledger, accounts payable and receivable, bank reconciliations, and month-end/year-end closing processes.
	Monitor budgets, project costs, cash flow, and profitability, providing timely financial reports and variance analyses.
	Manage tax compliance, statutory filings, and internal/external audits, ensuring adherence to regulatory and ISO 9001:2015 requirements.
	Establish and maintain effective internal controls, accounting policies, and financial risk management systems.
	Support procurement and project teams with financial evaluations, payment schedules, and cost control.
	Lead, supervise, and mentor the accounting team while driving continuous improvement in financial processes and reporting.


Qualifications and Experience
Education:


	ND, HND or Bsc in Accounting, Finance, or related field.


Experience:


	Minimum of 4 years of experience in accounting.
	Strong knowledge of IFRS, Nigerian tax laws, and ISO 9001:2015 documentation requirements.
	Proficiency in accounting software (e.g., Sage, QuickBooks, or ERP systems) and MS Excel.


Note


	Only candidates residing within Alimosho Local Government Area are eligible to apply.
	Only successful candidates will be contacted.

Reservoir Engineer Job at Ellasot Consulting




        
    

        
        Ellasot Consulting - Our client, a reputable Oil and Gas company, is recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Reservoir Engineer

Job Location: Port Harcourt, Rivers
Employment Type: Full-time

Description
     

            
    




	We are seeking a competent,detail-oriented,experienced Reservoir Engineer to support its portfolio of oil & gas reservoir assets.
	The ideal candidate would be responsible for providing high-level technical leadership across Reservoir engineering activities, supporting strategic field development decisions, optimizing hydrocarbon recovery, and collaborating with a multidisciplinary team, including geoscience, Petroleum Engineering, Production, drilling, wells, and facilities


Key Responsibilities


	Lead collaborative projects with engineers on teams to analyze field performance and advise on improving recovery
	Proactively engage with business stakeholders to address challenges, deliver solutions, and drive process improvements
	Drive team engagement with technical experts to generate insights based on analysis of data and analytical & numerical models
	Lead engineering teams and provide effective guidance to team members
	Develop the technical capabilities of team members through training and coaching
	Integrate with adjacent disciplines such as wells, development planning, geoscience, etc. to implement field development plans
	Proactively engage with business and technical stakeholders to identify challenges, develop solutions and drive continuous improvement
	Collaborate with technical experts to generate actionable insights from reservoir, production, and subsurface datasets
	Lead Technical workshops, peer reviews, and knowledge-sharing sessions
	Ensure Reservoir engineering activities comply with applicable company standards, industry best practices, HSE requirements, and HSE expectations


Requirements


	Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Petroleum / Chemical / Mechanical / other relevant engineering disciplines
	Minimum 8 years of experience in Reservoir Engineering
	Experience in leading teams and integrated reservoir projects
	Experience in performance monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimization of reservoir development
	Strong knowledge of reservoir engineering concepts
	Strong fundamental understanding/experiences in fluid mechanics, porous media flow, and computational fluid dynamics
	Experience with Engineering Applications such as IPM, Eclipse, Petrel RE, Intersect, or CMG
	Strong fundamental Understanding of Fluid Mechanics, porous media flow, and computational fluid dynamics


Note: Only Candidates in Port Harcourt or willing to relocate to Port Harcourt will be considered.

Procurement Specialist Job at Ellasot Consulting




        
    

        
        Ellasot Consulting - Our client, a Reputable Company, is recruiting to fill the position below: 

 Job Position: Procurement Specialist 

Job Location: Port Harcourt, Rivers 
Employment Type: Full-time (Remote) 

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a competent, detailed orientedProcurement Specialist (Remote) to join its team.
	The ideal candidate would be responsible formanaging the sourcing and procurement process for client Requests for Quotation (RFQs), ensuring timely, competitive, and technically compliant supplier quotations.
	The role involves engaging OEMs, authorized distributors, local representatives, and international buying houses to secure the best pricing, lead times, and commercial terms while supporting successful bid submissions within strict deadlines.


The Key Responsibilities


	Review customer RFQs and interpret technical and commercial requirements.
	Source competitive quotations from OEMs, authorized distributors, local representatives, and international buying houses.
	Identify and evaluate alternative suppliers that meet client specifications and quality requirements.
	Build, maintain, and strengthen relationships with global OEMs, manufacturers, and strategic suppliers.
	Ensure supplier quotations are obtained within bid submission timelines.
	Evaluate supplier quotations based on technical compliance, pricing, delivery schedules, warranty, and commercial terms.
	Collaborate with engineering, sales, and commercial teams to resolve technical and commercial queries during the bidding process.
	Maintain and continuously update a comprehensive supplier database covering major oil and gas equipment manufacturers and distributors.
	Conduct market research to monitor supplier capabilities, pricing trends, product availability, and industry developments.
	Verify that supplier quotations comply with client specifications, contractual requirements, and company quality standards.
	Support the development and implementation of sourcing strategies that improve bid competitiveness, supplier performance, and procurement efficiency.
	Maintain accurate procurement records, supplier communications, and quotation documentation.
	Ensure compliance with company procurement policies, ethical sourcing practices, and industry standards.


Requirements


	Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Procurement, or a related discipline.
	Minimum of 3–5 years of procurement, strategic sourcing, or bid support experience within the oil and gas, EPC, or energy sector.
	Professional certification such as CIPS, CPSM, or equivalent is an added advantage.
	Proven experience supporting RFQs from International Oil Companies (IOCs).
	Strong network of OEMs, authorized distributors, local representatives, and international buying houses.
	Ability to source technically compliant quotations within aggressive bid timelines.
	Good understanding of oil and gas equipment, materials, and procurement processes.
	Strong commercial acumen, supplier negotiation, and cost optimization skills.
	Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel for quotation analysis, cost comparisons, and bid evaluation.
	Working knowledge of SAP Ariba and other procurement or ERP systems.
	Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
	Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities.
	Ability to manage multiple RFQs simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
	High level of integrity, professionalism, and commitment to quality.


Salary
N250,000 - N350,000 per month

Note: Only candidates resident in Port Harcourt and Lagos will be considered.
